base.lattice: Moser lattice Z<1, z6, w3, z6*w3> in K = Q(sqrt3,sqrt11)

claim_scope: EXACT throughout: every radicand computed in K, squareness decided by the tower, no float in any verdict (floats appear only in the radius cut and in sort keys). ENUMERATION: all ordered pairs of the 87 distinct squared radii of THIS base; a different base has a different spectrum and this count does not transfer. REJECTED-IN-K counts pairs whose rotation lies in K(i), where Theorem B four-colours the union. A class listed here ADMITS cross edges of >=1 kind; admissibility is NECESSARY for a type-M construction and is NOT sufficient -- no claim is made that any of these yields a 5-chromatic graph.
